description: Render source code into a ДСТУ 19.701-90 (ГОСТ/ISO 5807) flowchart. Returns a PNG image by default (jpeg/webp/gif/gif_anim also come back as images; svg/typst/excalidraw/html as text; pdf/docx/visio as a download link or base64). Requires the Pro plan; each exported file counts toward the plan's monthly limit (another format of the same file is free). Tip: for a language we don't parse (assembler, pseudocode, etc.), set lang='rombik' and pass `code` as an astJSON flowchart tree built per the rombik skill — Pro only.

code.description: Source code to render (provide this OR url)

fn.description: Render only this function by name

format.description: Output format: docx (native Word shapes), visio (native .vsdx shapes), drawio (editable diagrams.net), typst, excalidraw, svg, pdf, json, html (self-contained page: chart + source code; with fragment=true — just a <div> to embed), jpeg, webp, gif, gif_anim (animated GIF: the chart draws itself block by block), png (default)

fragment.description: With format html: return only a <div> with the inline SVG chart (no page, no CSS) to paste into an existing web page. With format typst: a fragment without the preamble

labels.description: Block text: code (as in source, default) | math (no language syntax: d = 0, b² − 4ac, √d, and/or) | words (fully in words: d дорівнює 0, a менше 20, Замінити a на b) — for teachers who require no code inside blocks

lang.description: Language: python|cpp|c|csharp|java|pascal|javascript|typescript|php|go|rust — OR 'rombik' to pass a flowchart structure directly as astJSON (Pro only; charts ANY language/pseudocode without a parser — see the rombik skill for the schema). REQUIRED when you pass code; with url it is inferred from the file extension.

mode.description: Diagram type: empty for a flowchart (default), or 'nsd' for a Nassi-Shneiderman structogram (nested boxes, no arrows) — works with any format

options.description: Chart style switches (all optional, Pro on the account; the same keys as the HTTP API options): ifCascade (if/elif/else as a staircase: Yes goes down into the action, No goes right to the next diamond — as many teachers' manuals draw it), forAsWhile (for without a hexagon: i = 0, an i < n diamond, i = i + 1), doWhileLoopOnYes (do…while: Yes loops back), arrowsUpOnly (arrowheads only on lines going up or right-to-left — loop returns and merges; lines going down or to the right have none), jumpLines (a labeled break/continue that leaves several loops drawn as a line instead of the default lettered connector circles), forLabels (Yes/No labels on the exits of the for-loop hexagon, as ISO 5807 asks for every multi-exit symbol; off by default like most handbooks), mergeOffset (the two branches of an if/else join the axis at different points, the right one lower, as ISO 5807 asks for junctions; off by default), arrowsAtBlocks (no arrowhead where one line joins another — only where the joined line enters a block, as some handbooks draw it), blockNumbers (a number on every block in a gap of its top outline, to refer to blocks in the text; Start/End counted but not numbered), singleEnd (one shared End), mainOnlyTerminators (subprograms use Entry/Exit), callAsProcess, returnAsIO, stripTypes, noCaption — booleans; yes/no, inWord/outWord, startText/endText, entryText/exitText, returnWord, capWord, capFormat, forFormat comma|range|verbose — strings; figStart — number. locale and labels above win over the same keys here.

preset.description: Chart style preset: default | classic (condition chains as a staircase, loops as decision diamonds — textbook style) | short (Т/Н, Fig., i = 0..9) | terminators (Entry/Exit, one End, return as output) — or the code of a saved profile (from a link /app?m=CODE). options apply on top of it.

split.description: Split tall charts into parts with А/Б connectors. Default true for docx, pdf (multi-page) & Typst document; set true to also split svg / png / jpeg / webp / gif / html / excalidraw. Set false to keep one continuous chart (one sheet).

url.description: Fetch source from an allowlisted URL instead of code

name: render_flowchart
